summary.text: Kathy Schmaltz is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 46 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Kathy Schmaltz's general-election opponent is Jan Maino (D).
Before entering the legislature she worked as a news anchor and writer and as public affairs director of the Michigan State Radio Network.

paragraphs.text: Kathy Schmaltz was born in Birmingham, Michigan, and earned a B.A. in communication arts from Michigan State University in 1980.
Her career experience includes working as a freelance broadcaster and fundraiser, a news anchor and writer with WILX-TV 10, and the public affairs director of the Michigan State Radio Network.
Schmaltz served on the boards of the Michigan Education Trust and the Michigan Hospital Finance Authority.
Schmaltz assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023.

In 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Communications and Technology, Energy, Health Policy, and Families, Children, and Seniors committees, the last of which she chairs, as well as the Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses.
